exato.Bloqueia canais, filmes e séries adultos: Blocks adult (+18) channels, movies and series with a 4-digit password. The default password is 0000: create your own and choose a secret question to recover it. Press OK to open (asks for the password).
exato.Use quando algo estiver desatualizado ou: Use this when something is out of date or slow. Press OK to clear.
exato.Reinicia o aplicativo e carrega tudo de: Restarts the app and loads everything again (list, categories and license). New versions of the app arrive through the TV’s app store. Press OK to update.
exato.O VLTV Play é um reprodutor de mídia. El: VLTV Play is a media player. It does not include any channel, movie, series or list: the content comes from the service you subscribed to on your own, and the app only plays it.
exato.Você ainda usa a senha padrão (0000). Cr: You are still using the default password (0000). Create your own to really protect the content.
exato.Com o bloqueio ativado, categorias, cana: With the block on, adult categories, channels and movies ask for the password (or are hidden). Once typed, the password unlocks the content until you go back to the home screen.
exato.Escolha o idioma do aplicativo. A mudanç: Choose the app language. The change applies right away: the app restarts by itself.
